articles.title: England thumped by Tonga in World Cup opener
articles.summary: England were handed a Rugby League World Cup reality check after a 30-12 thumping by Tonga in their tournament opener.

articles.title: England record dominant win over Wales at Women's Rugby League World Cup
articles.summary: Connie Boyd and Anna Davies both notched hat-tricks as England recorded a dominant 70-6 rout of Wales in their opening game of the Women's Rugby League World Cup.
